function.description: Returns the names of all equipment in the warehouse. It takes no input parameters. The result contains only a list of equipment names and no other information.

Returns the category of a specified equipment item. Its only required parameter is equipment, which must be non-empty and exactly match an equipment name in the records. The result contains only the category string.

Exactly matches a category and returns all equipment names in it. Its only required parameter is category, which must be one of manual_equipment, power_equipment, measuring_and_testing_equipment, lifting_and_moving_equipment, access_equipment, safety_equipment, cleaning_equipment, storage_equipment, consumable, or other. The parameter cannot be empty or omitted, and new categories cannot be invented. The result contains only a list of equipment names.

Returns the brand of a specified equipment item. Its only required parameter is equipment, which must be non-empty and exactly match an equipment name in the records. The result contains only the brand string.
Exactly matches a brand and returns all equipment names made by it. Its only required parameter is brand, which cannot be empty or omitted. The result contains only a list of equipment names.

Returns the country of origin of a specified equipment item. Its only required parameter is equipment, which must be non-empty and exactly match an equipment name in the records. The result contains only the English country name.

Exactly matches a country of origin and returns all equipment names from that country. Its only required parameter is country, which must be a non-empty English country name and cannot be omitted. The result contains only a list of equipment names.

Returns the purchase date of a specified equipment item. Its only required parameter is equipment, which must be non-empty and exactly match an equipment name in the records. The result contains only a date string in strict YYYY-MM-DD format.

Returns all equipment names whose purchase dates fall within the specified inclusive range. Its two required parameters are start_date and end_date, both non-empty YYYY-MM-DD strings; start_date cannot be later than end_date. The result contains only a list of equipment names.

start_date.description: Inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: Inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

function.description: Returns the ideal_storage_location of a specified equipment item. Its only required parameter is equipment, which must be non-empty and exactly match an equipment name in the records. The result contains only the ideal storage-location string.

Exactly matches a location and returns all equipment names assigned to it. Its only required parameter is location, which must be one of dry_equipment_cabinet, locked_equipment_cabinet, wall_rack, pegboard, drawer_unit, parts_bin, shelving_unit, floor_storage_area, charging_station, safety_equipment_cabinet, chemical_storage_cabinet, or outdoor_storage_shed. The parameter cannot be empty or omitted, and new locations cannot be invented. The result contains only a list of equipment names.

Returns the usage dates of a specified equipment item. Its only required parameter is equipment, which must be non-empty and exactly match an equipment name in the records. The result is a list of YYYY-MM-DD strings, or an empty list when there is no usage history.

Returns a dictionary of maintenance and usage instructions for the requested equipment, including periodic maintenance actions and the maximum service life. Its only required parameter is equipment, which must be a non-empty list of exact equipment names from the records. Each result key is an equipment name and its value is that equipment's instructions.

equipment.description: Non-empty list of exact equipment names.

function.description: Returns the maintenance records of a specified equipment item. Each record contains only date and action. Its only required parameter is equipment, which must be non-empty and exactly match an equipment name in the records.

Appends one new equipment action on every successful call and never updates, replaces, or removes an existing entry. The same equipment and required_action may therefore have multiple scheduled entries, including entries with different due dates. Its four required parameters are user_id, equipment, required_action, and due_date. equipment must exactly match an equipment name in the records. required_action must be either a periodic maintenance action prescribed for that equipment (clean, inspect, lubricate, calibrate, sharpen, or condition) or a lifecycle action (replace, repair, relocate, or dispose). due_date must be a YYYY-MM-DD date. No parameter may be empty or omitted. The result contains only an addition success message.

Removes only the action whose equipment, required_action, and due_date all exactly match an entry in the specified user's list. Its four required parameters are user_id, equipment, required_action, and due_date. required_action must be one of clean, inspect, lubricate, calibrate, sharpen, condition, replace, repair, relocate, or dispose. due_date must be a YYYY-MM-DD date and exactly match the stored due date. No parameter may be empty or omitted. The result contains only a removal success message; an error is returned when no action matches all three fields.

due_date.description: Due date of the exact action to remove in YYYY-MM-DD format.

function.description: Returns all current equipment actions for a specified user. Its only required parameter is user_id, which cannot be empty or omitted. Each returned entry contains only equipment, required_action, and due_date.
